verdicts.reason: A blows the type up so far that '20% off' nearly touches the right edge. The top block is jammed, with the headline sitting across the cut-off circle, while the can floats alone in a large empty middle zone below the CTA. B neatly puts the can inside the full circle as a hero, with a clean left-aligned stack of eyebrow, headline, subcopy, CTA and legal text. Its only flaws are a slightly empty top band and a modest headline size.
